contributions.statement: Wrap the existing agent CLI in a plan -> develop -> independent-test loop where the tester's evidence pack updates the plan each round; at equal pass count this beat simply letting the same agent continue, and two rounds beat three plain continuations at fewer tokens.
contributions.evidence: §4.3 Table 2 (Codex/GPT-5.5, GameCraft): HoH 59.71/64.84/71.52 vs Vanilla Continuation 49.58/54.99/58.24 at 1/2/3 passes; HoH@2 5.67M tokens vs Vanilla@3 6.33M. Table 3: removing evidence feedback -6.28 pts. One configuration, single runs; games, no Java.

contributions.statement: Warm-start each loop iteration from the previous increment's code and on-disk state instead of regenerating from an empty workspace.
contributions.evidence: Table 3: w/o warm-start -7.85 pts and tokens 8.41M -> 11.12M; audit notes the 'every task' claim is false (Lighthouse 81.50 vs 80.90) and cells are single runs.

reason: The pass-matched continuation control is what separates this from the usual 'our loop beats one pass' system paper, and it is host-agnostic like qr. Role separation itself is never isolated.
